name: London open ORB 5 break (03:00–03:05), follow, flat 08:25
why: The first minutes of a session settle the orders queued for the open; a close beyond that range means one side's resting orders are used up and the stops beyond it add fuel. European cash open. Pre-registered 2026-10-18 (research/preregistered/2026-10-18_session_cockpit.md).
